summary: A preempted request reloads its prefix from LMCache instead of recomputing it
compatibility: No user action required. Applies to the regular LMCache path (CACHE_MODE=lmcache on the DeepSeek profiles, or RECURRENT_CHECKPOINT_POLICY=aligned); request-boundary checkpoints on GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8 are unchanged.
details: When vLLM preempted a request under KV memory pressure, the request resumed by recomputing its whole prompt and output, even when LMCache held them. Long multi-turn sessions showed occasional large prefills.

A resumed request now loads the prefix LMCache holds, as upstream LMCache #5248 does. Stores still in flight finish before the preempted request's freed GPU blocks are reused, so no other request's KV can be written under its keys.
